question: Can a truth-blind single-door GroundingDINO top-1 box plus SAM2.1 native mask replace privileged provider target masks while retaining the unchanged full-context RoMa NONE-aware result?

predecessor.single_change: Replace each exact provider target-visible mask with a highest-score single-prompt door box converted to one native SAM2.1 mask; preserve complete-frame RoMa input, matcher, cycle thresholds, assignment, cohort and scenarios.

source.scene_scope: The consumed final four exactly-one-door SceneNN scenes 074, 109, 005 and 076; use truth only after proposal selection for evaluation diagnostics.

proposal.processor: Frozen Transformers 5.14.1 GroundingDINO-Tiny defaults; single candidate-label list [door].
proposal.selection: Sort strict-threshold detections by descending score, box coordinates and postprocess index; retain exactly top one without truth, provider geometry, mask IoU or temporal information.
proposal.mask: SAM2.1-Hiera-Small, full RGB plus the retained box, multimask_output=false, official native-size postprocess at mask_threshold 0.0, no morphology, no IoU-score selection.
proposal.failure_semantics: If any of eight frames has no strict door proposal or no non-empty native mask, stop without a valid algorithm result.

renderer.near_plane_face_rule: reject unless every vertex is beyond near plane
renderer.visibility_rule: target depth finite and no farther than full-scene depth plus 0.005 m

matcher.absolute_support: Unchanged bilateral one-percent proposal-mask cycle fraction and majority cycle purity.
matcher.zero_assignment: Unchanged strict reciprocal maximum among absolutely supported pairs.

forbidden_after_freeze: change prompt, GroundingDINO thresholds, top-one selection, SAM mask postprocess, matcher, support thresholds, assignment, cohort, frames, targets, scenarios or gate
select a proposal using truth overlap, provider instance identity, geometry, temporal correspondence or RoMa outcome
merge, dilate, erode, expand, shrink or replace a failed proposal after outcome
call this consumed posthoc result fresh, source-disjoint, phone-runtime, named-entrance, ownership, access, traversability, arrival, handoff, benefit or safety evidence
claim_boundary: A pass is consumed SceneNN Development evidence that one truth-blind open-vocabulary box-to-mask proposal carrier can preserve the confirmed full-context correspondence mechanism in exactly-one-door indoor scenes. GroundingDINO and SAM2.1 run on desktop GPU here; this is not measured Android deployment and does not establish multi-door target selection, provider-disjoint generalization, named entrance, venue ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, reliability or safety.
